This is a re-creation of JD Thur's LHD : Grid Train System

https://factorioprints.com/view/-LFqwpqqNH64ixq6Ih5M

I simply couldn't find a better modular rail system that suited my needs, however Space age broke everything, so I rebuilt it from scratch

V.2 update addresses missing signals on the junction preventing trains passing each other.
title: Paul's Rail V.2
